name: io.github.giancarloerra/socraticode
description: MCP server for enterprise local codebase indexing, semantic search, and code dependency graphs.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider to use: ollama (default), openai, google, lmstudio, or litellm

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for OpenAI embeddings (required only when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for Google embeddings (required only when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=google)

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Ollama server (default: auto-detected; Docker-managed or http://localhost:11434)

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults per provider; required for lmstudio and litellm)

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Embedding vector dimensions (defaults per provider; required for lmstudio and litellm)

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Ollama mode: auto (default), docker, or external

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for authenticated Ollama proxies. Remote endpoints require HTTPS; loopback HTTP is supported.

environmentVariables.name: LMSTUDIO_URL
environmentVariables.description: LM Studio OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:1234/v1)

environmentVariables.name: LMSTUDIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key when LM Studio authentication is enabled

environmentVariables.name: LMSTUDIO_ALLOW_MISSING_MODEL_LISTING
environmentVariables.description: Allow compatible embedding servers without a models endpoint to be probed directly

environmentVariables.name: LITELLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LiteLLM master or virtual API key (required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=litellm)

environmentVariables.name: LITELLM_SEND_DIMENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Forward the dimensions parameter through LiteLLM when explicitly enabled

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Qdrant mode: managed (default, Docker-managed) or external (user-provided instance)

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full URL for remote/cloud Qdrant (e.g. https://xyz.cloud.qdrant.io:6333). Only needed when QDRANT_MODE=external

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for remote Qdrant instance. Only needed when QDRANT_MODE=external
